transfer-list.purpose: Move users, vehicles, roles, permissions, or stations between available and selected sets with search, review, and reversible feedback.
useWhen: Users need to assign many entities from one set to another.
Search, selection, review, or permission rules affect transfer.
The transfer changes membership, access, routes, or assignments.
doNotUseWithoutReview: A simple Select or Multi Select is enough.
Source, destination, permission, or audit policy is unclear.
foundations: Defines two-pane layout, action column, density, and responsive stacking.
Owns available/selected labels, count, empty, and confirmation copy.
Controls selected, disabled, warning, and transfer action states.
Selected, moved, empty, filtered, disabled, pending, saved, and error states are explicit.
Confirmation and review layer above panes when needed.
Counts, movement direction, and selected state are text-backed.
slots: Counts, saved state, or blocked transfer.
variants: Move users or roles between sets.
motion: Item appears in destination after explicit action.
accessibility: Keyboard users can select and transfer.

canDecide: Use Transfer List for assigning entities between two sets.
mustAsk: Source, destination, permission, audit, or persistence policy is unclear.
Transfer affects access, finance, compliance, legal, or identity state.
rejectIf: A simpler Select/Multi Select is enough.
miel.handoff: Confirm source, destination, allowed moves, search, selection, audit, confirmation, and persistence behavior.
